title: Grateful Dead Live at Shrine Auditorium on 1967-11-11
lineage: SBD Reel from WB Vault to reel @ 7.5 IPS to reel@ 7.5 IPS to digital domain. Korg MR 1000 at 1 bit 5.6 mhz to 24-96 via Korg software. Taped by: Dan Healy; Transfer By: Matt Smith & Bob Menke; Mastering By: Derek McCabe

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a raw, high‑energy 1968‑era show featuring smoking New Potato Caboose, Cryptical Reprise and an Alligator→Caution saga.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its surprising clarity given the vintage equipment, with a solid remaster that lets every psychedelic tumble shine. Musically the performance is described as a “psychedelic extravaganza” – New Potato Caboose, Cryptical Reprise and the Alligator→Caution stretch are highlighted alongside killer Lovelight solos and an intense Death Don't Have No Mercy.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (4‑5) across eight reviews, with strong praise for both the show’s energy and the recording’s clarity.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note the tape sounds clear and dynamic despite being recorded on an old 8‑track machine; the recent remaster is called pristine, with no significant dropouts or muddiness mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A seamless, improvisational flow that builds from raw early‑Dead energy into a psychedelic climax; the band rides the momentum through extended jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Two favorite Lovelight solos highlighted – one with distorted hammer‑on phrases and another with machine‑gun riffing; his tone is praised as “splitting the fabric of the universe.”
